rubrics.justification: The response misstates the Gardner components by calling 3BA an A-level ICM and B-level TE; in standard notation 3BA means ICM B and TE A. It also mentions blastocoel 'collapse dynamics' and a reasonably continuous TE, which are not reliably discernible from this single blurred image.
It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle, and relates them to prognosis.

The structure is logical overall, but the prognosis is partly built on the incorrect interpretation of the embryo grade and likely over-attributes reduced implantation to endometriosis without stage-specific data.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based: single embryo transfer at age 31, appropriate caution about add-ons, luteal support per protocol, and selective rather than routine PGT-A. Minor issues include the grading error and somewhat speculative sperm DNA fragmentation emphasis.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, cavity assessment after repeated failures, endometriosis review, and avoiding unnecessary add-ons, though some advice remains somewhat general.
